new_test_model_inference_calls_unit: Assigned benchmark records with durable results; the extra interrupted attempt is accounted separately.

physical_pairing_limit.statement: This pair does not satisfy the protocol statement that both arms use the identical in-memory quantized model object. Matching files/configuration does not prove identical live quantized tensors or identical transient execution conditions.
physical_pairing_limit.disposition: Retain the pair in all 200 assigned records; do not drop or rerun it.

interrupted_wall_time_bounds.note: Exact process-exit wall timestamp was not emitted; do not present the confirmation upper bound as exact generation cost.

attempt_accounting.cost_note: Recorded completed-call tokens exclude the unknown output tokens of one extra interrupted attempt. Quality assignment remains 200, not 201.

comparison_scope: Same frozen checkpoint/configuration; 99 complete pairs run within one process, with the disclosed row36 cross-process exception. Identical files do not prove identical live quantized tensors across reloads.
limits: Fictional model-authored, model-reviewed examples are not human gold or live-user evidence.
500 training updates are 100 families; test100 are20 correlated families.
Teacher-forced one-step prior state including10 designed wrong-text priors; no own-state rollout or accumulated error recovery.
No chat/work integration, final-answer correctness, deployment/user outcome or arbitrary model-transfer benefit is tested.
Single training/evaluation pilot with an operational restart; no causal claim about why slowdown occurred or why resumption progressed.
Completed generation and integrity checks do not establish successful answers or reduced intention omission.
No raw held-out outputs, blind packets, mappings, labels, weights, tokenizer payloads or semantic results are included.
No inference was started by this export operation; the reported 200 records and extra attempt are the completed study execution.
